basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old technology enthusiast living in Seoul, South Korea. Originally from Canada, I moved to Seoul for work as a software developer specializing in mobile applications. My hobbies include exploring new tech gadgets, gaming, and diving into the latest software innovations. I enjoy K-pop and Korean cuisine, and I'm often found hanging out in trendy cafes during my free time. Despite my busy schedule, I try to maintain a work-life balance by spending weekends hiking in the nearby mountains. I'm single, and my typical online hours are late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from a Canadian university, I have a strong foundation in programming and software development. My expertise expanded through self-teaching and hands-on experience with mobile application development, particularly for Android devices. I'm always eager to learn about the latest technological trends and apply them in my projects.
